overall_quality.evidence: One of the most fascinating facts I know is about the human brain's capacity for memory. The human brain has an extraordinary ability to store and recall information, and the amount of data it can hold is truly mind-boggling. Scientists estimate that the human brain can store around 2.5 petabytes of information. To put this into perspective, 2.5 petabytes is equivalent to about 2.5 million gigabytes, which is more data than could be contained in all the books ever written!
